lines: Sprite ids outside the saved state (static, from every create/free): +0 door (TT intro), +2 flame, +4 saloon / Puzzle picture / explosion, +6 dynamite, +8 fuse rectangle, +0xa cursor, +0xc first and +0xe second enlarged picture, +0x10 eight top and +0x20 eight bottom wipe strips.

Pairs II state, 0x564 bytes; events 0x33/0x34 hand back this address and size (literal 0x564 at 0x2da064). Layout in docs/games_pairs2_3310.md. Runtime: +0 time 0x32 at board 0, +2 card count 4, +0xd phase 2/0/8/4.
state+0x524: card indices in column order, built by pairs2_column_order_2e9eb2, walked by keys 2/8.
One u16 sprite id per card (state+0x564, not saved; rebuilt on resume).

Scratch block outside the saved state: +0 s8 vertical-bounce direction, +1 final-boss volley counter, +2 burst pause for pattern-20 fire, +4 u16 sprite currently flashed, +8 pointer to the active y-path table, +0xc boss-fire cooldown, +0x10.. tile pointer arrays filled by si_new_game.
8 pointers, one per level, to that level's array of 32-byte tile bitmap pointers (inside si_work). Filled by si_new_game.
8 pointers, one per level, to a 32-byte tilemap in ROM (0x311740..0x31181f; levels 2 and 3 share 0x311760). Filled by si_new_game.
Space Impact state, 0x34c bytes; event 0x33/0x34 hands this address and size to the framework. Layout in docs/games_applications_3310.md.
RAM copy of si_type_frames_init_2f3108: per object type, pointer to its array of 12-byte sprite descriptors.
RAM copy of si_level_table_init_2f30d4: 8 pointers to the 16-byte level headers.

Snake II globals: +0 u16 collection mask (bit 15 enables the large creature, bits 0..9 collected; loaded from record +0x2a by games_ctx_load with bit 15 = (0x111507 != 0)), +2 s16 board x offset, +4 s16 board y offset (both 0), +8 pointer to the state. Runtime: 0x80 written to +0 at boot (init table 0x2f4224), 0 at the Games menu.
Pointer to the Snake II state (0x10c9bc), set by new game and by event 0x33.

Snake II state, 0x2b0 bytes (event 0x33/0x34 hands this address and size). +0 tail index, +2 head index, +4 ring modulus 299, +8/+9 head cell, +0xc/+0xd tail cell, +0x10 direction, +0x11 previous direction, +0x12 ring of 300 sprite ids, +0x270 board w/h, +0x274 occupancy ptr, +0x278 maze record, +0x27c food, +0x284 creature cells, +0x294.. sprite ids, +0x29c period, +0x29e..+0x2ac flags; layout in docs/games_snake2_3310.md. Runtime: fields traced with a frame-polling Lua probe.
Seed of game_rand16_2dd7d0. 1 after boot; sprite_engine_init reseeds it from the clock when the clock is set (runtime: stays unseeded in MAME).
RAM copy of 0x2f2350: ten 12-byte sprite descriptors for the 4x5 HUD digits, glyphs at 0x10dbe0 (ROM image 0x2f2320).

Bantumi drawing block: +0 player-won flag, +1 sound pending (return 0x1b), +2..+4 intro slide step/toggle/board frame, +5 winner digits draw mode, +8/+0xc hand mask/image sprite ids, +0xa board sprite, +0xe thinking sprite, +0x10 hand closed, +0x14..+0x43 four RAM hand descriptors, +0x44 hand animation state (1 wait, 2 move, 3 arrive, 4 act), +0x48 counter, +0x49..+0x4c hand x,y and target x,y, +0x50/+0x68 closed-hand bitmaps.

Bantumi game state, 0x28 bytes (the block saved on suspend, events 0x33/0x34): pits[14] (0..5 player, 6 player store, 7..12 computer, 13 computer store), +0xe cursor, +0xf computer's chosen pit, +0x10 hand pit (0xff while thinking), +0x14 u32 turn (0 intro, 1/2 hand to pit, 3 player, 4 computer, 5 game over pause, 6 hint, 7 done), +0x18 game-over countdown 40, +0x19 level 1..5, +0x1c sow pit, +0x1d seeds in hand, +0x1e/+0x1f thinking frame/countdown, +0x20 sow sub-state, +0x24 capture store. Runtime: pits, turn and level logged in MAME.
14 x {u16 units digit sprite, u16 tens digit sprite}, one per pit, digits from game_digit_sprites_10db68 in draw mode 2.

Bantumi search block: +0 u8 chosen pit, +1 u8 depth remaining, +4 root node, +8 current node. Nodes are 0x20-byte heap records: +0 side (3 player, 4 computer), +4 alpha, +6 beta, +8 best (s16), +0xa pits[14], +0x18 first move (0xe none), +0x19 counter, +0x1c parent.

Per-game record, 0x2c bytes each. Snake II (id 0): +0 result word, +2 u16 top score, +4 level 0..8 (ctx+0x16 = +4 + 1), +0x28 maze 0..5 (ctx+0x17 = +0x28 + 1), +0x2a u16 collection mask. Runtime: writing +4 and +0x28 from Lua changes the game's level and maze.
Four 0x1c-byte records, one per tone class. +0xe: the class is switched on; +0x14: the script being played. Class 0 is the games' sounds, class 1 the keypad tones.

Title handlers' state: +0 Bantumi second-round flag, +1 step counter (SI, Bantumi, Pairs II at 0x110d61), +2 Snake II step, +0x14/+0x16 saved ctx+0xc/+0xe, sprite ids from +4 (Snake II), +6 (SI), +0x24 (Bantumi).
Framework state: +0 suspended flag, +2 u16 last key code | 0x80 for repeat, +4 u16 game id, +8 pointer to the active context.
Context passed by games_dispatch_2dbd2a to the title handlers (ids 0x80..0x84).
Context passed to every game handler in r1. +0xc u16 tick period ms, +0xe u16 one-shot delay ms, +0x10 u32 score/result, +0x14 u16 sound id, +0x16/+0x17 settings.

Games setting byte next to Sounds (0x111505) and Shakes (0x111506); games_ctx_load copies whether it is nonzero into bit 15 of the Snake II collection mask, which the large creature requires. Meaning inferred only; 0 in MAME.
Sprite engine: +0 u16 free-list head, +2 u16 sprite count, +4 pointer to the 0x1c-byte sprite records (heap), +8 dirty flag.
Seed of the ANSI rand at 0x2f1b44.
Byte game_vibrate_2dd70e requires nonzero before vibrating. Runtime: 0 on a fresh NVRAM in MAME, so no game vibration starts there; inferred to be the presence of a vibra battery.
Index of the selected game (0 Snake II, 1 Space Impact, 2 Bantumi, 3/4 Pairs II).
Marks all 60 object records free (type 0x32) and clears the object count at state+0x2a.
Writes a decimal number into a chain of digit sprites: (first sprite id, value, digits). Follows the sprite next links, so digit sprites must be created consecutively.
Sets the vertical play limits at state+0x318/+0x319: (0x20, 6) with ground terrain, (0x2a, 0x10) when the terrain is on the ceiling (arg 0x2b).
Creates the HUD sprites (5 life icons, special icon, 2-digit special count, 5-digit score) and the terrain layer via tilemap_init; levels 4 and 5 put the terrain at the top.
Copies a 16-byte level header to state+0x31c, resets sprites and objects, rebuilds the HUD, sets phase 10.
(type, draw mode, x, y) -> sprite id. Creates the sprite with the type's first frame and copies the 12-byte template. Refuses when 40 objects exist.
Redraws special count, score and the life icons (shown for index < lives).
(ctx, 10 = new ship | 0x14 = respawn). Places the ship at (5, 20) with a shield sprite (type 8) at (3, 18); sets ctx period 100 and one-shot 3000 ms, which is the shield time.
Events 0x24/0x2b. Allocates 60 sprites, fills the tile and tilemap pointer tables, lives 3, special 3 x missile, continues counter 4, loads level 0.
On the continue screen (phase 0x14), keys 1/3/4/6 restart the current level from its beginning with 3 lives and 3 missiles. The level load clears the checkpoint byte before this function reads it.
Key handler while playing. 8/0 move up/down, */# left/right (1 px, repeat codes 2 px), 1/3 fire, 4/6 special. Sets ctx+0x14 to the sound and the pending return to 0x1b.
Builds the continue screen: remaining continues as icons, a countdown digit, tick period 800 ms, phase 0x14.
Event 0x35. Re-allocates the sprite engine and recreates every sprite from the saved object records and their saved x/y.
Level 7: spawns the final boss (type 0x22) and its two parts (type 0x23) when the scroll position reaches 0x7a, 0x13a or 0x1ba.
Runs the level script: counts down the delay, then spawns the next entry's group and records checkpoints. y 0x3f picks a random row with the ANSI rand.
Returns 1 with probability 1/N, N the object's fire byte (0 and 0x7f never fire), using game_rand16.
Spawns an enemy bullet (type 4) at the object's left edge if it has shots left (bosses have unlimited shots).
Vertical bounce between the play limits and off the terrain; may fire.
Boss shot: spawns the given projectile type at an offset, with a 6-tick cooldown.
Moves a boss left 1 px per tick until x <= 0x38; returns 1 once in place.
Final boss state machine on state+0x47 (0x32, 0x3c, 0x46, 0x50).
Boss charge and retreat state machine on state+0x47 (10, 0x14, 0x1e, 0x28).
Restores a sprite's draw mode for the level polarity after a hit flash.
Pattern 23. Per-level boss behaviour: levels 0-1 bounce, 2 charge, 3 bounce and fire type 0x15, 4-6 charge and fire, 7 the final boss.
Pattern 22: bobs a final-boss part with the boss animation frame.
Frees the sprite and the object record; clears the missile target and boss part ids that pointed at it.
Frees the object when its x is 0 or has wrapped (>= 0xfb).
Patterns 17/18: move left, sliding along the ceiling or the floor.
Patterns 1 and 10..16: move left by the speed and take y from the active y-path table indexed by x mod 84.
True for types 0, 1, 2, 8, 9, 10, 0x16, 0x24: objects that are not targets.
Returns the enemy with the most hit points.
Frees the object when x + width passes 84.
Pattern 9: the missile moves right 2 px per tick and steers 1 px per tick toward its target's centre.
Pattern 7: move left, climb to the ship's row around x 40..42 and fire when level with it.
Pattern 6: move left by the speed.
Pattern 5: move right by the speed (player bullets).
Pattern 4: move left, climbing between x 0x1d and 0x38.
Pattern 3: move left and step 1 px toward the ship's y.
Pattern 2: move left, descending between x 0x1d and 0x38.
(kind, amount, ctx). 0x11 bonus: random life/missile/wall/beam; 0x21: +3 specials; 0x31: add score, capped below 31500.
Boss kill: explosions, +100, state+0x47 = 0x7f, phase 0x1e (level exit).
Beam special: damages every enemy within 3 px of the beam column as it sweeps.
Per-tick walk of the object list: animation, explosion end, ship death, then the 24-entry movement pattern switch at 0x259718.
Bounding-box overlap of two sprites.
First non-player object whose box overlaps the given sprite.
Pixel-exact overlap between the ship and an object, honouring the level polarity.
Tests a shot against a boss bitmap along its row; returns the row distance or 0.
Hit flash: hides the sprite for a tick (mode 6) and remembers its id.
Per-tick collisions: ship against terrain and enemies, then every player shot against terrain and enemies, with damage and scoring.
All events except start. 1 = tick, 0 = one-shot timer (shield off), 0x33/0x34 state query/suspend, 0x35 resume; keys go to si_key or si_continue_key first.
Game id 1 entry called by games_dispatch: 0x24/0x2b start a new game, everything else goes to si_event.
(ctx, first digit sprite): draws the s16 at ctx+0x12 (low half of the score) as four decimal digits into sprites first+3 (units) .. first+0, using game_digit_sprites_10db68.
(units sprite, value): value > 0 shows sprites id, id+1 and id+4 (mode 4) and sets the units and tens digits; value <= 0 hides them (mode 6). The creature countdown and icon.
(out, board) -> first cell with a clear occupancy bit in row-major order from (0,0); returns 0 when the board is full.

Food placement (board, food sprite, creature cells, out): up to 100 tries of x = rand16 % w, y = rand16 % h, accepted when the cell is free and shares no row or column with any creature cell; then the first free cell; none: (-1,-1) and the sprite hidden. Sprite at (2+4x, 10+4y). Runtime: positions reproduce from seed 1.

Creature spawn (board, &sprite, cells, food, icon sprite | mode<<16): rand16 % 50 == 0 with mask bit 15, mode 1 and state+0x2aa == 0 tries the 2x2 animated creature, else a 2x1 creature with kind rand16 % 6 (pictures 0x327e1c). 100 tries each, cells free and clear of the food's row and column. Returns 1 when placed. Runtime: spawned on the 5th food with countdown 20.

Tail removal (snake, board): clears the tail cell's occupancy bit, advances the tail index mod 299, moves the tail cell to the next segment's, gives that segment the tail image (0x327ef4 + direction to the next segment) and returns the old tail sprite for reuse as the head.
(board, snake, food, creature cells) -> 1 when the cell ahead of the head (with wrap) is the food or a creature cell: the head is drawn with its mouth open (0x327f84).

Head step (snake, board, sprite or 0, &swallow flag, food, creature cells, creature sprite): ring full (head+2 == tail mod 299) -> returns 100; creates a sprite when none is passed (growth); moves the head with wrap, sets its occupancy bit, head image (closed or open), stores the sprite in the ring; on a creature cell hides the creature and clears the two cells away from the travel direction; re-images the neck (straight/corner, fat when the swallow flag is set) and clears the flag.
(maze, board): draws the playfield frame (four fill sprites around x 0..83, y 8..47) and one 2-px fill sprite per maze segment through the cell centres.
(board, maze record): sets the occupancy bit of every cell of every wall segment (horizontal or vertical runs of 8-byte {x1,y1,0,0,x2,y2,0,0}), then draws with 0x274f0c.
HUD: four score digit sprites at x 0,4,8,12 (mode 4), countdown digits at x 79,75,71,67 and the creature icon at (66,1) (mode 6, hidden), and the rectangle line at y 6.
Food and creature init at new game: food sprite (0x327e10, mode 1) then a random placement, creature cells cleared, creature sprite (mode 1) off screen, counter and active flag 0.

(state, snake index, board, &food-eaten flag) -> nonzero when the cell ahead (with wrap) is blocked: its occupancy bit, except that the tail's cell is blocked only when the snake grows this step. Snake records are 0x26c bytes apart; only snake 0 exists. Runtime: walls and the body block.
Large creature eaten: sets a random clear bit 0..9 (rand16 % 10, retried while set) in the collection mask at 0x10c9b0 and sets state+0x2aa. Loops forever if all ten bits are set.
Frees the occupancy bitmap (state+0x274) if allocated.

Suspend: packs each ring entry tail to head into a u16 (x bits 0-4, y bits 5-10, image index bits 11-12, kind bits 13-15 found by comparing the sprite's bitmap pointer with the image sets) and the creature's kind into state+0x296.
Resume: rebuilds maze, every segment sprite and its occupancy bit from the packed ring, HUD, score, food sprite, creature sprite and countdown.

Game id 0 entry (Snake II). 0x2b/0x24 new game, 1 tick, 0 blink step, keys via the jump table at 0x275b28, 0x33/0x34/0x35 state query/suspend/resume, 0x13/0x15/0x17/0x18/0x1a end a dying game, 0x1c. Runtime: returns 0x21, 0x1b (eat, sound 0x1f), 0x16 (grace 100 ms), 0x1f (death, sound 0x20), 0x20 (blink), 0x18 (game over).
Jump table for game events 0x0a..0x16 (keys 1..9, 0x13, #, 0x15, *). Keys set the pending direction at state+0x2a3 from the current one; runtime-verified for all of 1-9, # and *.

New game (reached by bl from the handler, returns through 0x276642): board 20x9, period = level table * 10 ms, maze record, start cell, direction right, occupancy and sprite engine (w*h+29), event 0x2b also resets the ring and fills the maze; seven head steps then one tail removal leave 7 visible segments. Runtime: first frame shows cells 5..11 of row 4.
Inside new game: allocation-failure exit returning 2; the code after it is the rest of new game.
Handler exit returning 1 (movs r7,#1 falling into 0x276642); reached by bl as a long branch.
Common handler exit: returns r7.
Inferred from its use with timer ids 0x32, 0x37, 0x38.
(id, ticks). Inferred. 0x32 game tick, 0x37 one-shot, 0x38 key repeat (12 ticks).
Inferred.
Inferred.

(arg) Draws the hand: arg 0 frees the old pair first. Open hand (0x10e188 == 0) 12x16 from 0x31d120/0x31d0f0 (bottom row, state+0x10 <= 6) or 0x31d138/0x31d108 (top); closed hand 11x13 from 0x31d198/0x31d150 or 0x31d180/0x31d168. Bitmaps are copied to RAM, shifted up and shortened when y < 0; mask sprite mode 0 then image mode 1, layer 3, at (0x10e1c1, 0x10e1c2).
Returns 1 when pits 0..5 or pits 7..12 are all empty.

(pit, n): sets the pit's count and updates its digit sprites. One digit at (x+4, y+2) for pits, (x+5, y+5) for stores; with two digits the tens sprite is created at (x+1 / x+2) and the units moved 4 px right; going back below 10 frees the tens sprite.

(arg) End of a move: hand idle, hand sprites freed; arg 1 passes the turn (3 <-> 4), arg 0 keeps it (last seed in the store). If a row is empty, sweeps each row into its owner's store, sets the won flag or blinks the computer's store (mode 5) and turn 5. Else: player's turn draws the open hand at the cursor; computer's turn starts the search (0x2dd3bc) and the thinking sprite at (34,16). Runtime: logged at every move end.

(from, to) Starts a hand animation: state 1, counter 2, start and target positions from the pit table 0x31d1ec with row-dependent offsets (bottom row y-14 start, y-4 pick-up / y-11 sow target; top row y+10 start, y / y+7 / y+10 target); special starts at the stores when turning a corner.

(pit) Picks up a pit's seeds: next pit = pit + 1, hand animation, frees the thinking sprite (computer) or the hand pair (player), closed hand, seeds in hand = pit count, pit emptied, sow sub-state 1. Runtime: logged at each pick-up.

(frame) Resets all sprites and draws board frame 0x31d0c0 + 12*frame at (0,0), mode 4, layer 0. Frame 0 also draws the hand (or the thinking sprite when state+0x10 is 0xff) and creates the 14 digit sprites. Used by new game (frame 3), the intro (2, 1, 0) and resume.

New game: 45 sprites, cursor 0, turn 0, four seeds per pit, stores 0, level = ctx+0x16, game-over countdown 40, closed board (frame 3) at x = 40, tick 120 ms; returns 0x16 (2 when the sprites cannot be allocated).

Bantumi event handler: tick (hand animation states, sowing and captures, intro, search steps, game over), keys 4/6 and scroll (cursor), 5/0/event 8 (sow), * (hint at level 1), suspend/resume; returns 0x1b when a seed was dropped (sound 0x1b) and 0x1e at game over with ctx+0x10 = pit 6 - pit 13.
Game id 2 (Bantumi). Events 0x24/0x2b: ctx+0xc = 120, new game 0x2b1c10; others to 0x2b1cc0. Runtime: called through games_dispatch_2dbd2a with id 2 when Bantumi is played.

(rows, cols): x0 = 7*((12-cols)>>1), y0 = 9*((5-rows)>>1) + 4 if rows even (lsrs/bhs at 0x2c6498); cards row by row on a 7x9 pitch, card back 0x31afc4 mode 4 layer 1 created at (0x27,0x14); state +0x25 = 8; Puzzle picture 0x31afb8 at (0,0) layer 0 into 0x1090e0. Runtime: level 1 first card at (35,13).
Puzzle board from level (state+0xc): 2x2 at level 1, else cols = 2(L-1), rows = L/2+2; deal(rows*cols), shuffle, layout, column list.
Time trial layout: 10 column-mask bytes at 0x32fe74 + 10*board; bit r of byte c puts a card at (12+7c, 1+9r); stores the count at state+2. Runtime: board 0 cards at (33,10),(54,10),(33,28),(54,28).
Time trial board: deal(count from 0x32fee4[board]), shuffle, layout, column list; saloon 0x31afac (mode 4, layer 0) at (0,0) into 0x1090e0, door 0x31afa0 at (0x20,0x11) into 0x1090dc.

Per play tick: fuse top (state+5) += 1 when time % state+4 == 0; flame frame toggles (0x31af7c + 12*toggle); fuse rectangle remade (mode 1, layer 3, x 4, y 0x1e..top); flame moved to (0, top-5). Runtime: top 8 -> 9 at time 48 on board 0.

Event 1. Puzzle in phase 4/7: period 200 (0x16 if changed), removal animation per card (frames 0x31ad60, state 0..7 -> 9; 0x18 in phase 7 when done). Phases 2/3: deal step. Time trial only: countdowns (phase 0 -> 8, phase 1 -> next board or 0x18 after board 8, bonus time/2), wipe (phase 8), HUD removal (9), explosion (5), time decrement and level period 300/267/233/200/167/133/100 ms (0x2c6ab8). Runtime-confirmed periods 0x12c and 0x64.
clamp(x, 0, 0x4c).
Second enlarged picture (8x11, mode 4, layer 2, id at 0x1090ea); if it would overlap the first (|dx| < 8 and |dy| < 11) it is pushed clear and the clamp shortfall moves the first (0x1090e8).
After a pair: if a card is still face down, cursor to the next one (2e9fca(3)); else Time trial: free cursor, target := current position, phase 9; Puzzle: phase 7. Clears state+3, +0xa.

Key 5 with one card open. Returns 0 (miss: state+0xa = 2) or 1 (pair: TT frees both sprites, state 9; Puzzle starts the removal animation, state 0). Runtime: return 0x1b with sound 0x1c and +5 at level 1.
(card): enlarged picture 0x31adc0 + 12*picture at (clamp_x(x), clamp_y(y)), mode 4 layer 2, id into 0x1090e8. Runtime: card at (33,10) shows its picture at (33,9).
Key 5 with no card open: show picture, face up, first card := cursor, cursor to the next face-down card; state+0xa = 1. Runtime: cursor 0 -> 1.
Returns the byte at vibra_present_11fcbd.

Builds the Space Impact title: 37-sprite pool, full-screen fill, 30 random 1x1 stars (mode 3), ship 0x31889c at (0,18), hidden 0x3188a8/0x3188b4/0x3188c0, logo halves 0x3188cc (7,1) and 0x3188d8 (3,32). Runtime frames match.
Step k: logo halves to y k+1 and 32-k; k 1..5 ship to x 4k; k 6..8 swap to the next hidden picture.
SI title events: tick steps 1..8, 9 sets 700 ms, then ends (0x10); keys end it.
Title id 0x81 (Space Impact): saves ctx+0xc/+0xe, period 210 ms (0xd2), si_title_start; other events to si_title_event. Runtime: steps ~0.2 s apart, menu 0.9 s after the last.
Snake II title build: allocates 6 sprites, creates the 84x48 picture 0x318318 and five hidden overlays (0x318324..0x318354) at x 6.
Ticks 1..5 show the frame at +0x18+2k and hide the previous (0x318324 never shown, runtime-confirmed), 6 sets 1200 ms, then ends.
Handler for id 0x80, the Snake II title: on 0x24/0x2b saves ctx+0xc/+0xe, sets a 250 ms tick and builds the title; other events step it.
Builds the Pairs II title: 9-sprite pool, background 0x318f20 (card backs).

Jump table on step 1..8: adds 0x318f2c (6,7), 0x318f38 (3,1), 0x318f44 (3,1), 0x318f50 (19,1), 0x318f5c (35,1), 0x318f68 (38,1), 0x318f74 (35,1), 0x318f80 (35,25), mode 4 layer 0. Runtime: frames match the stacked composites.
Pairs II title events: steps 1..8, step 9 sets 1400 ms, then ends (0x10); keys end it.
Title ids 0x83 and 0x84 (Pairs II), period 200 ms. Runtime: receives 0x2b, ticks, then a key (event 9 for Select) and 0x34.
Creates the title picture 0x3185c4 (mode 4) and six hidden overlay sprites (mode 6) at (23,18), (34,23), (37,33), (45,19), (53,15), (62,27).
Title init: 7 sprites; draws the title unless the event was 0x24.
Title step: hides the previous overlay, shows the current one (mode 4); returns 0x16.
Title events: each tick advances the overlay (70 ms after step 3, 250 ms otherwise), two passes, 700 ms on the last frame, then returns 0x10 restoring ctx+0xc/+0xe; keys end it at once.
Runtime: two rounds from 14.85 to 17.18 s in a scripted run.
Game id 0x82: Bantumi title. Static: games_dispatch_2dbd2a calls it for id 0x82 with context 0x1111f8. Saves ctx+0xc/+0xe, sets a 250 ms tick.
Returns the byte at 0x11fe97 after writing it to NV key 0x5b0d. The game vibrates only when it is 0; inferred to be a charger's presence.
For i in 0..n-1 swap the 20-byte card record i with record game_rand16() % n.
Moves each card's current x/y (+0x28/+0x2c) 1 px toward its place (+0x30/+0x34) and its sprite; in phase 3 frees cards already in place; returns 1 if any moved. Runtime: 15 ticks on board 0.
Returns 0 if any card has +0x26 == 0.
Dead code (no caller, no pointer): picture 0x21 phase 6 for 40 ticks, 0x22 shows every card, 0x23 adds 30 ticks to the time (max 150).
(n): count, phase 2, cursor 0, time = 0x32fed0[board], fuse divisor time/25, fuse top 8; cards 0..n/2-1 and n/2..n-1 get pictures 0..n/2-1, state 8, face down.
Dead code: from board 2, the pair with picture rand16 % n becomes picture 0x21..0x23.
sprite_engine_init(90), reset, reseed, first board by mode; returns 2 for 0x24 or failure, 1 for 0x2b.
Event 0x35: recreates background (and TT HUD), cards on the board, cursor; between boards deals the next one; Puzzle phase 7 returns 0x18.

Every event but start: tick, keys 2/4/5/6/8 in phase 4 (0xb, 0xd, 0xe, 0xf, 0x11), 0x33/0x34 state, 0x35 resume; match: ctx+0x14 0x1c, score += level+4; miss: 0x1e, score -= 1 if > 0; return 0x1b. Runtime-confirmed.
Game ids 3 (Time trial, ctx+0x17 = 0) and 4 (Puzzle, ctx+0x17 = 1). 0x24/0x2b: ctx+0xc 200, score 0, board 0, mode, level; else pairs2_event.

(id, ctx): loads the per-game record into the context: ctx+0x10 result word (+0), ctx+0x16 level + 1 (+4), ctx+0x17 = 0 for id 3 and 1 for id 4 (Pairs II's Time trial and Puzzle), else record +0x28 + 1 (Snake II's maze). For games whose table flags have bit 3, copies the collection mask at record +0x2a, with bit 15 set when games_setting_111507 is nonzero, to snake2_globals_10c9b0.
(game id, event) -> handler(event, ctx). Ids 0..4 are the games with game_ctx_111218; 0x80..0x84 are their title screens with a second context at 0x1111f8.
Application handler shared by all games. Translates phone events to game events and acts on the handler's return code (timers, sound, game over).
(terminal) Evaluates the current node: pit 13 - pit 6; terminal nodes add computer row - player row and +-50; negated for side 3. Runtime: model matches all logged searches.

(node, terminal) Closes a node: evaluate if terminal or depth 0; negate when the side differs from the parent's; raise parent best (records the chosen pit at the root), parent alpha = max(alpha, best); depth + 1; frees the node.

(parent, pit) Makes a child: copies pits, sows (computer skips 6, player wraps at 13); store landing keeps side and window, else side flips with (-beta, -alpha) and captures. Quirk: the computer's capture tests the live board 0x10e1f8 and is credited to pit 6. Runtime: child order logged and matched by the model.
Starts a search from the live board: computer side 4 with depth 2*level-1 (9 becomes 8), or for the hint (turn 6) side 3 depth 5. Root alpha -32000, beta 32000.

First move heuristic: a pit that ends in the store (scanning down from the store, which itself matches when empty), else the last pit with the largest capture value read at 13-(k+c), else the fullest pit.
Next move of the current node: the heuristic pick first, then pits in order skipping it; +7 for the computer.

One tick of search: up to 100 iterations; at the end the computer's choice goes to state+0xf/+0x10, turn 2 and a hand animation, or for a hint into the cursor with turn 3. Runtime: tick counts match the model (1 to 242 ticks).
Frees every node of a running search (used before restarting it on interrupting events).
Heap allocation followed by a clear.

Starts a short vibration: timer 0x39 at 0x3e = 62 units, when Shakes (0x111506), vibra_present_11fcbd, vibra_profile_2e944e == 1 and charger_state_2d7f82 == 0 allow it. Called on ship hits and boss explosions; each call restarts the timer. Runtime: about 0.5 s of vibration in MAME.
(id, descriptor): copies a 12-byte sprite descriptor into the sprite and marks it dirty.
Sets game_rand_seed from 0x2cc440 (clock) unless it returns the unset value.
Unlinks a sprite and returns it to the free list.
seed = (seed * 0x625f + 0x3623) mod 0xfff1; returns the seed.
(id, x, y).
(id, x, y, w, h) for rectangle sprites (the beam).
Clears every sprite and rebuilds the free list.
(n): allocates a private pool of n sprites for a title, saving the game's engine header.
Allocates n sprites of 0x1c bytes; reseeds game_rand16 from the clock if it is set. Returns 1 on success.
(flag) Writes 0x111af9 in the sprite engine block. Inferred: requests a full redraw; Bantumi calls it with 1 while the hand moves and on thinking frames.
Frees a title's pool and restores the saved engine header.
(id, mode): draw mode in bits 3..5 of the flags byte. 0 clear bits clear; 1 set; 2 flip; 3 inverse; 4 opaque; 5 opaque and blink; 6 hidden.
Takes a sprite from the free list and links it in layer order.
(descriptor, mode, layer, x, y) -> id.
Creates a rectangle sprite (kind 1).
Creates a fill sprite (kind 2); used for the full-screen background on inverted levels.

Called by games_app_handler after each handled event. Erases and redraws the sprites that changed and every sprite overlapping them (0x2dfa0a), in list order (0x2dfbe4), or everything when the engine's dirty flag is set.
(layer, scroll x): draws rows of 32x8 tiles into the layer bitmap, 84 px wide, wrapping at width * 32.
(layer, width in tiles, rows, map, top flag, tile pointers, mode): allocates rows * 84 bytes and creates the layer sprite at the top (0x2b) or bottom of the 48-row screen.
Pixel overlap between a sprite and the terrain layer.
Starts the vibrator: cancels timer 0xf, derives a level from 0x2d8094's result clipped to 2..0x1c, writes PUP vibrator mode 0x60 with it through 0x2f13e8, and starts timer 0xf at 11 units.
Returns 1 unless the profile byte at 0x111a79 is 0x40 or 0x41, then 2, and writes the result to NV key 0x7501. The game vibrates only on 1.
Start of the column list: the first card (index 0).
(card): first card with the same x and a greater y, else 0xffff.
(card): card with the smallest x greater than the card's (lowest index among equals), else 0xffff.
Builds the column list at 0x1096b4: down each column, then the top of the next.
When state+0xa == 2: both cards face down again, enlarged pictures freed, cursor mode 2.
(0 up, 1 down): steps through the column list with wrap, skipping face-up cards. Runtime: up from card 2 of a 12x5 grid to 49, down from 50 to 3.
(2 left, 3 right): index -1/+1 with wrap, skipping face-up cards.
Sets the tone classes' switches from the profile block. Class 0 is on when the block's byte 6 is 4; inferred to be Warning and game tones.
(0, class argument, id): posts the sound's record in sound_table to the tone task. Games call it as (0, 0xf1, ctx+0x14) on return code 0x1b/0x1f when their sounds are on (0x111505).
Signed remainder in r0 (quotient in r1).
Unsigned remainder in r0.
ANSI rand: seed = seed * 0x41c64e6d + 0x3039; returns (seed & 0x7fffffff) >> 16.
